bifrost: No SDK or shell API for disk mount or unmount events. Partial system-layer disk enumeration in springboard/src/installer/disks.rs (lsblk, findmnt) and unmount in springboard/src/installer/plan.rs (installer only). Files shows no volumes (docs/bifrost-ui.md:571).
summary: BifrOSt has no mount, unmount, eject or disk-appearance API for apps, and no register-and-block (approval) mechanism. Disk handling exists only in the installer, which enumerates and erases disks with lsblk and findmnt, and the Files sidebar has no Volumes section.

features.feature: Disk description and lookup (DADisk, DADiskCreateFromBSDName, DADiskCreateFromVolumePath, DADiskGetBSDName, DADiskCopyDescription)
features.apple: DADisk.h: DADisk, DADiskCreateFromBSDName, DADiskCreateFromVolumePath, DADiskCopyDescription, DADiskGetBSDName
features.note: Installer-only, shell-side, uses lsblk output. No app-facing disk object, no description dictionary, no volume-path lookup.

features.feature: Session and run loop or dispatch queue scheduling (DASession)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs (NotificationCenter-based workspace events, no disk events)
features.note: No disk session. Workspace events cover apps, sleep and wake only.

features.feature: Mount, unmount, eject and rename commands (DADiskMount, DADiskUnmount, DADiskEject, DADiskRename)
features.note: Installer unmounts its own target; no app or shell API to mount, eject or rename a volume.

features.feature: Disk appeared, disappeared and description-changed callbacks (DARegisterDiskAppearedCallback, DARegisterDiskDisappearedCallback, DARegisterDiskDescriptionChangedCallback)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs:226 (disk_stamp watches only the apps directory, not block devices)
features.note: No event when a USB stick or disk appears or leaves. disk_changed is an app-install stamp and is unrelated to hardware.

features.feature: Mount and unmount approval (DARegisterDiskMountApprovalCallback, DARegisterDiskUnmountApprovalCallback, DARegisterDiskEjectApprovalCallback)
features.note: No hook that lets an app or policy block a mount, unmount or eject. DADissenter has no counterpart.
No exclusive-use claim on a disk. The installer uses shell commands, not a claim.

features.apple: Finder volume list (Disk Arbitration supplies the data; the UI is not in this framework)
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/files (no volume code); springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (grants confined to the account home)
features.note: docs/bifrost-ui.md:571 states mounted volumes and the Volumes section are not matched. Document grants cannot reach a mounted volume.

features.feature: Sandbox access to udev data for apps
features.apple: Not part of the framework (system-level device data)
features.note: The sandbox exposes device data to apps read-only, but no SDK API wraps it.

gaps: No disk mount, unmount, eject or appearance events for apps or shell (DARegister*Callback family).
No mount, unmount or eject approval hook, so nothing can block a volume change (DADissenter).
No app-facing disk or volume object with its description (DADisk, DADiskCopyDescription).
Files does not show mounted volumes or a Volumes sidebar section; document grants are confined to the account home.
No disk claim (DADiskClaim) for exclusive access.
The installer's lsblk and umount calls are not reusable by apps. Apple's framework runs on a daemon, which BifrOSt has no equivalent for.
